environment: Python 3.14.7, Node 24.19.0, gh and glab stub shims from the testkit, scratch git repos, worktree of sdlc/S-017 on branch sdlc/S-017-v0-contract-0

cases.title: Seven preflight scenarios hold through gh and glab shims
cases.given: A fixture repo with forge github or gitlab and a gh or glab shim on PATH.
cases.when: Run preflight for the seven R-074 scenarios, one after the other.
cases.then: Exit codes 0,0,1,0,0,1,2. Keys match the surface listing. Scenario 2 derives feature/sdlc/{name}. Scenario 5 has rules unknown and only unchecked samples. Scenario 6 fails the working sample bad-name with rule push rule. Scenario 7 gives one JSON error.
cases.expected: Exit codes 0,0,1,0,0,1,2. Keys match the surface listing. Scenario 2 derives feature/sdlc/{name}. Scenario 5 has rules unknown and only unchecked samples. Scenario 6 fails the working sample bad-name with rule push rule. Scenario 7 gives one JSON error.
cases.command: VERIFY_WORKTREE=<worktree of sdlc/S-017> node --test .sdlc/slices/S-017/verification/r0/tests/contract-0/preflight.verify-contract.test.mjs --test-name-pattern="seven preflight scen"

cases.title: glab ok path, mr without branch, pr mode regex failure
cases.when: Run preflight in mr mode with feat/x, in mr mode without --branch, and in pr mode.
cases.then: feat/x passes, no sample without --branch, pr mode fails with derived false.
cases.expected: feat/x passes, no sample without --branch, pr mode fails with derived false.
cases.command: VERIFY_WORKTREE=<worktree of sdlc/S-017> node --test .sdlc/slices/S-017/verification/r0/tests/contract-0/preflight.verify-contract.test.mjs --test-name-pattern="glab ok path and mr "

cases.title: Bad input exits 2 with one JSON error
cases.when: Run preflight with a repeated placeholder, an unknown mode, an empty format, an unknown flag and no arguments.
cases.then: Every run exits 2, prints one JSON line with the keys ok and error, and prints no usage text.
cases.expected: Every run exits 2, prints one JSON line with the keys ok and error, and prints no usage text.
cases.command: VERIFY_WORKTREE=<worktree of sdlc/S-017> node --test .sdlc/slices/S-017/verification/r0/tests/contract-0/preflight.verify-contract.test.mjs --test-name-pattern="bad input exits 2 wi"

cases.title: Same input gives the same output and the repo stays unchanged
cases.given: A gh shim with a starts_with rule.
cases.then: The two outputs are equal after the timestamp is masked. The scratch tree and git refs do not change.
cases.expected: The two outputs are equal after the timestamp is masked. The scratch tree and git refs do not change.
cases.command: VERIFY_WORKTREE=<worktree of sdlc/S-017> node --test .sdlc/slices/S-017/verification/r0/tests/contract-0/preflight.verify-contract.test.mjs --test-name-pattern="determinism and no m"

cases.title: derive matches the spec table (property)
cases.given: Random rule lists of length 0 to 3 with kinds starts_with, ends_with, contains and regex, negated at 30 percent.
cases.when: Call derive. Compare with a reference model written from the spec table.
cases.then: derive returns the table format for exactly one non-negated starts_with, ends_with or contains rule, else null.
cases.expected: derive returns the table format for exactly one non-negated starts_with, ends_with or contains rule, else null.
cases.command: VERIFY_WORKTREE=<worktree of sdlc/S-017> node --test .sdlc/slices/S-017/verification/r0/tests/contract-0/preflight.verify-contract.test.mjs --test-name-pattern="derive matches the s"

cases.title: judge matches rule semantics (property)
cases.given: Random rule lists and sample names.
cases.when: Call judge. Compare with a reference model of the four rule kinds and negate.
cases.then: Result is fail with the first failing rule label, else pass with rule null.
cases.expected: Result is fail with the first failing rule label, else pass with rule null.

cases.title: suggest always carries --branch-format after a loop failure (property)
cases.given: Random rule lists and three failing loop samples.
cases.when: Call suggest with the reference derived value.
cases.then: The suggestion starts with --branch-format and holds the derived format when one exists.
cases.expected: The suggestion starts with --branch-format and holds the derived format when one exists.

cases.title: CLI exit code equals ok across random rule sets
cases.given: 60 random rule lists served by a gh shim.
cases.then: Exit code follows ok. ok equals no failing sample. A derived format equals the reference derivation and every sample passes under it. A single negated rule never derives. A failing run has a suggestion with --branch-format. A passing run has an empty suggestion.
cases.expected: Exit code follows ok. ok equals no failing sample. A derived format equals the reference derivation and every sample passes under it. A single negated rule never derives. A failing run has a suggestion with --branch-format. A passing run has an empty suggestion.
cases.command: VERIFY_WORKTREE=<worktree of sdlc/S-017> node --test .sdlc/slices/S-017/verification/r0/tests/contract-0/preflight.verify-contract.test.mjs --test-name-pattern="CLI exit code equals"

cases.title: Consumer view from a scratch cwd
cases.given: The command run by its script path from a scratch directory.
cases.then: ok true and no samples, with the same surface.
cases.expected: ok true and no samples, with the same surface.

seeds.title: derive treats an empty pattern as not derivable
seeds.detail: The spec table would give sdlc/{name} for starts_with with an empty pattern. derive returns None. The result is the same in practice, because an empty pattern passes every sample.

seeds.title: preflight output holds the extra keys args and command
seeds.detail: The spec output example in section 4 shows no args or command keys. They come from the shared echo. The surface test pins them.
